strengths: Hook is a real, recognizable moment ("Good news, no one to tell?") readable at a glance and it sets up the whole thought.
Hook -> meaning -> question reads as one connected idea: no one to tell -> share it -> joy alone dries up -> who could you call.
Plate choices fit the lines: the banquet toast for "share it," the lone swan on still water for "dries up" -- both read as lake/joy imagery true to dui.
Drop lands cleanly: the question goes quiet (energy 1.0) right before the 14 s drop, then screen 1 hits on the jump to energy 8 with the planned zoom + shake.
End card and credit follow the series' held-card pattern and are legible and unhurried.

changes.change: Give screen 3 (YOUR DAY, READ) a beat longer, or simplify what's on it -- it's carrying a hexagram-change readout ("58 becoming 47") plus "Study this line" plus the day header in 2.5 s, which is more than a viewer can read once.
changes.why: showcase needs the viewer to register what each screen does in the time it gets; screen 3 has the densest text of the four and the shortest look.

changes.change: Hold on the fully-typed "READ THE STRUCTURE" title a touch longer before the whip cut, or start the reveal earlier so the mid-word state ("READ THE STRUC") doesn't land on a cut frame.
changes.why: legibility -- the drop-frame catches the title mid-type; even if it's just an animation in-between, it reads as clipped text at a glance.

review.notes: Can't hear the track, so can't confirm the whip-cuts on meaning/question actually land on-beat as described, only that the drop and the energy dip before it line up with the stills. Also can't confirm on-device contrast/legibility of the small green hexagram caption ("58 - Dui - The Joyous") against the rain background -- worth a quick look on a phone screen.
